_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Aircraft Store Loads Design Criteria Report
summary: This report describes the aircraft store loads criteria that will be used in the structural design of a store carried on an aircraft for all store variants.
use_relationship:
This report describes the aircraft store loads criteria that will be used in the structural design of a store carried on an aircraft for all store variants.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Aircraft Store Loads Design Criteria Report shall:

children.title: The following criteria & documentation requirements apply
children.content: The following criteria & documentation requirements apply to all store variants.

children.title: Loads documentation for all store variants shall include
All design weights as specified by the contract
Center of gravity (CG) envelopes
children.content: Center of gravity (CG) envelopes including weight CG diagrams and the derivations;

children.title: Design load factor and airspeed diagrams (V-n diagrams)
children.content: Design load factor and airspeed diagrams (V-n diagrams) for symmetrical and unsymmetrical flight;

children.title: Design load factors, airspeeds, and rotational velocities and accelerations
Elevated temperature criteria
Internal store pressure criteria
Design landing and ground handling operations
Design symmetric and asymmetric maneuvers
children.content: Design symmetric and asymmetric maneuvers, including steady state and dynamic maneuvers, resulting in high dynamic load amplification (i.e. buffet);

children.title: Spanwise load factor & V-M-T (Shear-Moment-Torsion) distributions
children.content: Spanwise load factor & V-M-T (Shear-Moment-Torsion) distributions along pertinent design axes for store (as stipulated by contract);

children.title: Six Degree of Freedom (6DOF) store center of gravity (cg) translational and rotational design accelerations
children.content: Six Degree of Freedom (6DOF) store center of gravity (cg) translational and rotational design accelerations (as stipulated by contract);

children.title: Store-to-rack interface definitions and loads
children.content: Store-to-rack interface definitions and loads including all swaybraces and hooks (as stipulated by contract);

children.title: Design load and/or actuation load requirements
children.content: Design load and/or actuation load requirements associated with door, panel, and/or turbine operation of radiating stores;

children.title: Store-to-store and store-to-aircraft clearances
Store handling, cradling, transport, and abuse criteria
All critical loading configurations as specified by the contract
Define the specific design conditions selected for analysis including
A list of store loading configurations selected for analysis
children.content: A list of store loading configurations selected for analysis, together with the basis for selection of those conditions and configurations;

children.title: A discussion of design features
children.content: A discussion of design features, which affect determination of critical conditions;

children.title: All sources of aerodynamic and inertial data
All methods and assumptions
children.content: All methods and assumptions to be used in the calculation of aerodynamic and inertial loads.

children.title: Define the structural capability by superimposing all
children.content: Define the structural capability by superimposing all limiting factors, including control power, angle of attack, and buffet, on altitude vs Mach number envelopes.

children.title: Define the effects of weight, CG, and
children.content: Define the effects of weight, CG, and variable geometry component positions;

children.title: Document a detailed description of the control
children.content: Document a detailed description of the control system, its components, and their functions.

children.title: Document the sources and complete explanations of
children.content: Document the sources and complete explanations of all loads on the system and its components.

children.title: Define the following data for field landings, arrested landings, Field Carrier Landing Practice landings, field takeoffs, catapults, taxiing, and ground handling
A summary of all in flight loading conditions
children.content: A summary of all in flight loading conditions that will be combined with inertial loads;

children.title: The catapult's horizontal accelerations used for each type of catapult
The arresting hook forces and horizontal accelerations
children.content: The arresting hook forces and horizontal accelerations used for each type of arresting gear;

children.title: The range of landing gear variation in servicing
children.content: The range of landing gear variation in servicing that will be used for design;

children.title: A summary of all ground handling, taxi, securing, and miscellaneous ground loading conditions
Substantiating data, pertinent references, and amplifying data
children.content: Substantiating data, pertinent references, and amplifying data showing that the derivations of the required range of parameters comply with contract requirements;

children.title: Drawings showing required attitudes with auxiliary doors
children.content: Drawings showing required attitudes with auxiliary doors in the fully extended and fully closed position relative to the store reference line;
